name: The Hanging of Judas
description: Palette extracted from the public-domain work “The Hanging of Judas” by Alsatian or Southern German (c. 1520), Art Institute of Chicago artwork 65795. Adapted for high-contrast GameCore 5.1 UI.
changelog: 1.0.0 — source-backed palette; ≥7:1 body text and ≥4.5:1 controls.
